def transform(grid):
    # The full-width 7 divider separates two masks; keep their overlapping cells.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 7 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    h, w = min(len(top), len(bottom)), len(grid[0])
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
